about: Run 1's first step replayed (2026-11-16): 256 of its T1 training problems with bank-v1 pass rates between 0.1 and 0.9 (shuffled with seed 20261115), 8 answers each from the SFT model run 1 started from, at 16K tokens and medium effort, temperature 1, graded with the training grader. by_budget['16384']['left out + penalty'] is run 1's rule: cut-off answers out of the loss, answers ending past 12,288 tokens docked up to 0.5. Counts only (scripts/talk/difficulty_pilot.py --max-tokens 16384).
